title: From a spare room to today
label: A company history on a vertical timeline running from 2019 at the bottom to 2026 at the top. A marker climbs the rail, its flag showing the year, and stops at each milestone: founded in February 2019, the first paying customer in May 2020, a $4M seed round in September 2021, and a team of 40 in June 2023. Each milestone fills in with one short line beside it. At the top the marker reaches today, November 2026, and a card opens: 2,400 teams use the product every week, built by 140 people in Lisbon, Toronto and remote.
heading:
How a spare room
became a company.
sub: The moments that shaped the company, from the first commit in 2019 to the people who rely on us today.

milestones.title: Founded
milestones.note: Two engineers, one spare room, a spreadsheet that kept breaking.

milestones.title: First paying customer
milestones.note: A 12-person logistics team in Rotterdam. They are still with us.

milestones.title: Seed round
milestones.note: $4M to hire our first designer and a support lead.

milestones.title: A team of 40
milestones.note: A second office opens in Toronto.

milestones.title: Today
milestones.note: Built by 140 people in Lisbon, Toronto and remote. We still answer support ourselves on Fridays.
